items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: People like John Lewis for example, with the Modern Jazz Quartet.

ctx.x: People like John Lewis for example, with the Modern Jazz Quartet. Now he's got some of the original Capital (secrets?) M

I think John saved those. But I haven't been that way so I really don't have anything like that. I have tapes that I still haven't heard, I want to hear you know. But I went through a phase where I would just walk over to the piano and press on the tape recorder and play something and never hear it again. I've still got some that I've never heard. You know, I'd get a little idea..... It's the wrong thing to do. I did myself a disservice, because when you do a thing like that you should play them over right away.
